title: Analyst Upgrades and Downgrades as Dell Price Targets Fall
summary: Six of seven firms tracked by Finbold cut Dell price targets after its record quarter, Autodesk targets were trimmed and ThredUp drew two downgrades.
body_markdown:
Bank of America's Wamsi Mohan retained a Buy rating and cut his target to $500 from $600, citing concerns about the sustainability of AI infrastructure spending and Dell's exposure to debt-reliant neocloud providers. Wells Fargo's Aaron Rakers kept an Overweight rating and lowered his target to $400 from $545, pointing to weaker PC demand. Dell's release shows Client Solutions Group revenue up 3% to $12.9 billion.


Raymond James's Simon Leopold kept a Buy rating with a target cut to $570 from $617, while Bernstein's Mark Newman trimmed his to $580 from $650 amid broader valuation concerns across AI-related stocks. Piper Sandler's James Fish made the smallest move, to $555 from $558, with an Overweight rating.


Morgan Stanley's Erik Woodring was the only raise in Finbold's tally, lifting his target to $408 from $403 with an Equal-weight rating after describing the quarter as very strong but largely in line with expectations.


## Autodesk Q3 EPS of $3.20 Tops $3.07 Estimate


Autodesk reported fiscal third-quarter[earnings per share](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/what-is-eps-earnings-per-share-meaning-formula-and-how-to-judge-it/) of $3.20 against $3.07 expected, on revenue of $2.16 billion against $2.13 billion expected, according to[Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/analyst-ratings/autodesk-stock-price-target-cut-to-310-by-da-davidson-on-valuation-93CH-5050677) . The company raised its full-year guidance for revenue, billings and operating margin, though its shares fell in after-hours trading after the report, the outlet said.


DA Davidson kept a Buy rating but lowered its target to $310 from $325, based on 21 times fiscal 2028[free cash flow](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/free-cash-flow-and-net-cash-flow-explained-2/) . The firm noted that its MaintainX revenue assumptions were left unchanged despite a strong contribution in the quarter, while management did not comment on the fiscal 2028 growth outlook.


Per the same report, Mizuho kept an Outperform rating with a $350 target, citing peer multiple compression. Goldman Sachs reiterated Neutral with a $265 target, Oppenheimer kept Outperform at $300 and KeyBanc reiterated Overweight with a $341 target.


## ThredUp Cut to Market Perform on Q4 Revenue Guide


ThredUp's own[third-quarter release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001484778/000148477826000031/exhibit991earningsreleaseq.htm) showed revenue up 7% to $88.2 million, with a record 1.82 million active buyers, up 16%, and 1.89 million orders, up 17%. Its fourth-quarter outlook calls for revenue of $77.0 million to $79.0 million, a 2% year-over-year decline at the midpoint, and an adjusted EBITDA margin of negative 4.0% to negative 2.0%.


Northland downgraded the stock to Market Perform from Outperform with a $2.00 price target after the company's second consecutive guidance reduction, as reported by[Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/analyst-ratings/northland-downgrades-thredup-stock-rating-on-discounting-pressure-93CH-5003465) . Northland said continued higher discounting to spur demand lowered average selling prices and cut into unit-level profits. William Blair also moved to Market Perform from Outperform, a call the outlet said was influenced by the revised guidance.


Investing.com put the shares at $2.19 on Nov. 5, down 72% over the past year based on InvestingPro data. "We're proud to report a record quarter for active buyers, orders and items sold, delivering clear value for our buyers in Q3," CEO and co-founder James Reinhart said in the company's release.
